```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
imgs <- list.files("images/gallery",
                   pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png|webp|JPE?G|PNG|WEBP)$",
                   full.names = TRUE)

if (length(imgs) == 0) {
  cat("::: {.note-panel}
The first photos will be posted here after the 2026 workshop in December.
:::
")
} else {
  cat("Click any photo to view it full size.\n\n")
  cat("::: {.photo-grid}\n")
  for (p in imgs) {
    cat(sprintf("![](%s){group=\"workshop\"}\n\n", p))
  }
  cat(":::\n")
}
```
